lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Zn2Sn2 (Mg6ZnSn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Mg, Sn, and Zn centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg, Mg–Sn, and Mg–Zn neighbor distances ranging from about 2.94 to 3.21 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, as well as edge- and face-sharing between Mg- and Sn-centered polyhedra.
